reference_opening.argument: This video is non-scam content because it discusses difficulty reaching eBay by phone and suggests email, cases, or direct chat as alternatives. It separately advertises a $20.20 reseller-training bundle with affiliate links disclosed, without connecting that promotion to deceptive conduct or requests for credentials, investment, or other financial participation.

citations.quote: you were probably unable to get in touch with eBay customer service over the phone
you may not be able to reach eBay's customer service call centers
you can still email them, of course, and submit cases or respond to cases as you should
you're gonna have to submit your emails and your messages or direct chat through eBay and try to work it out that way

opening.argument: The video pairs a low-cost acquisition with a direct action pathway: viewers are told to use an external link to obtain a reseller and social-media training bundle for $20.20. The bundle is presented as teaching sales across multiple platforms and includes extensive materials and community access. That is more than neutral customer-service reporting; it gives viewers a concrete purchase instruction tied to a claimed opportunity to learn how to sell online. The customer-service discussion supplies topical context, but the actionable commercial invitation is independently present and can steer viewers toward paying for the offered package.

citations.quote: 2020 Complete Reseller + Social Media Training Bundle: ($20.20) USE THIS LINK:
Learn how to sell on Ebay, Amazon, Poshmark, Instagram, Facebook, Twitter, Youtube & More for just $20.20 (1 time payment).
Hundreds of videos, guides, VIP group, webinars & more.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The service-update framing does not neutralize the separate solicitation. The description expressly directs viewers to use a link and pay for a bundle, so the content contains an acquisition pathway even if the spoken discussion also mentions email and chat. Calling those alternatives does not establish that the paid offer is independently reliable or that the commercial invitation is merely incidental.

citations.quote: USE THIS LINK:
for just $20.20 (1 time payment)

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The quoted material shows a disclosed, ordinary purchase offer, not a free reward, withdrawal promise, or income payment. “Learn how to sell” describes educational subject matter and does not promise earnings. The description also says the links may produce small commissions and that they do not increase the buyer’s price, which supports transparent promotion rather than a deceptive acquisition scheme.

citations.quote: Learn how to sell on Ebay, Amazon, Poshmark, Instagram, Facebook, Twitter, Youtube & More
Some links on this video may be affiliate links that can result in small commissions & help support the channel
they DO NOT cause you to pay any extra money for an item

opening.argument: Several risk signals appear together in the promotional material: an external shortened link, a very low one-time price, a broad promise of access to hundreds of videos and guides, and a private VIP group and webinars. The package is also advertised across many online selling and social platforms, making the offer sound broadly applicable while giving viewers a simple payment route. Even without a stated guaranteed return, this combination is designed to make acquisition feel easy and comprehensive. The disclosure of affiliate commissions identifies a financial incentive behind directing attention to the offer.

citations.quote: USE THIS LINK: https://sowl.co/bnh1qM
for just $20.20 (1 time payment)
Hundreds of videos, guides, VIP group, webinars & more.
Some links on this video may be affiliate links that can result in small commissions & help support the channel

rebuttal.rebuttal: The defense focuses on the customer-service topic while minimizing the concrete risk signals in the description. A disclosed commission is still a financial incentive, and the external link, one-time payment, broad platform coverage, and extensive-access language collectively make the offer a central participation route rather than evidence-free background material. The absence of a phone scam does not resolve that solicitation.

citations.quote: USE THIS LINK: https://sowl.co/bnh1qM
Hundreds of videos, guides, VIP group, webinars & more.
Some links on this video may be affiliate links

true_side_reply.rebuttal: These are not the category’s defining scam signals. The evidence shows a paid training bundle, not an unusually easy reward, an investment return, a wallet or credential flow, or a guaranteed financial outcome. The external link is plainly identified as part of the offer, and the affiliate relationship is disclosed. Broad coverage and a low price may be persuasive marketing, but they do not establish deception.

citations.quote: 2020 Complete Reseller + Social Media Training Bundle: ($20.20)
(1 time payment)
Some links on this video may be affiliate links that can result in small commissions

opening.argument: Although the speaker presents the video as a customer-service update, the surrounding material gives it a promotional role. The description places a paid reseller-training bundle, a large reseller community, and equipment links alongside the video, while also identifying affiliate commissions. This framing can use a timely eBay problem to attract viewers who are already seeking help with online selling, then redirect that attention toward paid resources and external links. The informational discussion therefore functions as a funnel into commercial participation, not simply an independent news or educational segment.

citations.quote: Complete Reseller + Social Media Training Bundle
Join the Thrifter & Reseller Facebook group community (110,000 members)
All of my Reselling & Youtube Supplies & Equipment:
many of you know yesterday which was March 17 2020 you were probably unable to get in touch with eBay customer service over the phone

rebuttal.rebuttal: The fact that the speaker discusses eBay access does not prevent the video from steering viewers toward associated commercial resources. The description promotes training, a large community, and supplies, and identifies affiliate compensation. Thus the customer-service subject can be read as attention-setting context for promotion, while the defense’s account omits the surrounding purchase and link activity.

citations.quote: Join the Thrifter & Reseller Facebook group community (110,000 members)
All of my Reselling & Youtube Supplies & Equipment:
affiliate links that can result in small commissions

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The presence of promotional links does not convert the spoken subject into a scam. The video’s substantive update concerns inability to reach eBay by phone and alternative ways to contact eBay. The description’s bundle is an openly priced training product, while the supplies links and affiliate compensation are disclosed. Nothing quoted shows fabricated credentials, guaranteed earnings, or a deceptive result from following the links.
